nodes.description: UniswapExchange.owner: privileged address controlling init, delegate, batchSend and setTradeAddress
UniswapExchange.balanceOf mapping of token balances, updated with raw unchecked arithmetic
UniswapExchange.allowance mapping mutated by transferFrom/approve
UniswapExchange.totalSupply set in the constructor
_onSaleNum mapping counting per-address sale transfers
canSale mapping acting as a transfer whitelist bypass in ensure
_minSale minimum sale threshold set by init
_maxSale maximum sale threshold set by init
_saleNum global sale counter set by init
tradeAddress whitelisted address set by owner
Constant UNI router address 0x7a25...488D used in ensure whitelist
ERC20._balances internal mapping
ERC20._allowances internal mapping
ERC20._totalSupply internal supply variable
UniswapExchange.transfer: payable entry that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
ensure: whitelist/blacklist gate combining owner, UNI, pair, tradeAddress and canSale checks with condition
transferFrom: allowance check, ensure gate, unchecked balance mutation and _onSaleNum increment
approve: writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly
condition: enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits on the sender
delegate: owner-only arbitrary delegatecall backdoor to address a with data b
init: owner-only setter for _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum
batchSend: owner-only loop distributing tokens with unchecked multiplication and duplicated Transfer events
setTradeAddress: owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist slot
pairFor: pure CREATE2-style pair address derivation used as whitelist oracle
UniswapExchange constructor: sets name/symbol/supply, owner = msg.sender and infinite UNI allowance
ERC20._transfer: internal balance movement with SafeMath guards
ERC20._approve: internal allowance writer
ERC20._mint: internal supply and balance increase
ERC20._burn: internal supply and balance decrease
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn: private helper executing a raw call and decoding optional return data
msg.sender: external caller identity used for allowance, ownership and whitelist decisions
delegatecall to an owner-supplied address executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context
